specs.source_title: Introduction to Bambu Nozzles | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: Types › A Series Nozzle › Max. Printing Temp
specs.quote: Compatibility:A2L/ A1 / A1 mini | Max. Printing Temp: 300 ℃
specs.conflict: Disagrees with the store page (Product Specifications › row 1 › pair 1: "Max. Printing Temp. 320 ℃"). Recorded at the store page's own rank (official_page, as the runner ranks wiki tables), so the merge keeps 320 °C, sets the row's conflict and writes spec_sources_disagree; owner to adjudicate. Outside this file's sources: the A1, A1 mini and A2L printer pages in the P0 corpus give "Max Hot End Temperature 300 °C".
specs.note: The wiki panel names the A Series Nozzle (purchase link bambu-hotend-a1-series; Size 0.2/0.4/0.6/0.8 mm; Materials hardened steel / stainless steel), i.e. this product.
